def locate(text, offset):
    # Normalize CRLF to LF for easier processing
    normalized = text.replace('\r\n', '\n')
    prefix = normalized[:offset]
    # Count actual newlines in original text (CRLF is treated as a single LF)
    line_count = prefix.count('\n') + 1
    # Get the last line (split on \n, take the last part)
    last_part = prefix.rsplit('\n', 1)[-1]
    # The column is len(last_part) + 1 (because the newline is part of the preceding line)
    return (line_count, len(last_part) + 1)

print(locate(text, len(text)))  # (3, 5) (last line ends at column 5)
print(locate(text, 100))  # reject: (None, None)
